annotations.title: Vendor check, supplier due diligence: website risk, domain age and sanctions screen

description: Screen a vendor before you buy from it: where its website really leads, the destination domain's age and trust flags, HTTPS and security headers, named risk signals and, with a company name, a sanctions screen (OFAC, EU, UN, UK). One verdict: pass, review or block. Heuristic signals from public facts, not legal advice. Use for supplier onboarding, marketplace seller checks or a payee's website before an invoice is paid. Example: domain=stripe.com. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

domain.description: The vendor's website or domain (a URL, a domain or an email address works)

name.description: Company name for the sanctions screen (recommended)
